title: [29.x]Reduce allocations in the "Export to Execl" scenario (#11870)
summary: The Export to Excel scenario now allocates significantly less memory by reusing a CellDecorator instance, eliminating redundant ExcelBuf record calculations, and reducing method call overhead during column processing.
key_points: Reuses the default CellDecorator instead of creating new instances for each column-row combination
Removes unnecessary ExcelBuf record instantiation that was only used to calculate cell format names
Reduces AL method call scope allocations during export processing
Decreases memory allocations from 168GB to 68GB for 100k G/L Entries exports
Reduces garbage collection pause time from 12.8 seconds to 5.7 seconds in test scenarios
quote: removes three easy allocations that was done for each column of each row
